description.value: Himalayan Momo Restaurant and Bar is a Nepali restaurant in downtown Vancouver specializing in handcrafted momos — Nepalese-style dumplings — alongside a broad menu of Himalayan, Indian, and Chinese dishes including tandoori chicken, biryanis, and traditional items like Sukuti (dried buffalo meat) and Jhol MoMo soup. The restaurant brings age-old Himalayan recipes made with locally sourced ingredients to the heart of the city, with full bar service and a warm, vibrant dining room. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver will find an extensive menu with dedicated vegetarian sections and the option to order online for takeout.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 55m; stands (3 spaces) at 63m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 71m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at himalayanvancouver.ca was successfully fetched and confirms the business is open at 622 W Pender St, Vancouver, with phone and email matching OSM tags exactly. The website's menu includes dedicated 'Veg Appetizers,' 'Veg Curries,' and 'Veg Foods' sections, corroborating OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes tag. No evidence appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those are left null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: Minor name mismatch: OSM uses 'Himalayan Momo Restaurant and Bar' but the website consistently displays 'Himalayan Momo Restaurant & Bar' (ampersand vs. 'and').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating full-service restaurant in downtown Vancouver with confirmed contact details, vegetarian options, and takeout availability — a useful stop for touring cyclists moving through the city core.
